```{=html}
<style>
.w061-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w061-dd .w061-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w061-dd .w061-step {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  cursor: grab; user-select: none;
}
.w061-dd .w061-step.w061-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w061-dd .w061-step.w061-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w061-dd .w061-step.w061-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w061-dd .w061-num { font-weight: 700; color: #d81e2e; min-width: 1.3em; text-align: center; }
.w061-dd .w061-txt { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w061-dd .w061-mv { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.w061-dd .w061-mv button {
  padding: 0 8px; line-height: 1.25; font-size: 0.8rem; border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w061-dd .w061-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w061-dd .w061-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w061-dd .w061-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w061-dd .w061-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w061-dd .w061-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w061-dd .w061-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w061-dd .w061-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w061-dd iw" id="w061-dd">
  <div class="w061-list" aria-label="handshake steps to order"></div>
  <div class="w061-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w061-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w061-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w061-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w061-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w061-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w061-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Each step needs the one before it: the hello opens the exchange, the certificate carries the server&rsquo;s public key, and the browser must verify it against a CA it already trusts before the key agreement &mdash; otherwise it could be agreeing a key with an impostor. Only then does slow asymmetric cryptography agree a fresh symmetric session key, and the fast symmetric key encrypts the rest: slow handshake, fast conversation &mdash; see <a href="#sec-06-tls">the section on TLS</a> and <a href="#def-tls">the definition of TLS</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w061-dd');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w061-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w061-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w061-expl');
  // STEPS[i] is the step whose correct position is i (0-based).
  const STEPS = [
    'The browser sends its hello to the server',
    'The server returns its certificate, carrying its public key',
    'The browser verifies the certificate against a CA it already trusts',
    'The parties agree a fresh symmetric session key (asymmetric cryptography)',
    'The rest of the connection is encrypted with the session key (symmetric)'
  ];
  const START = [1, 3, 0, 4, 2]; // fixed scrambled display order (no step in place)
  let picked = null;

  function rows() { return [...list.querySelectorAll('.w061-step')]; }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w061-picked');
    picked = null;
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    rows().forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w061-right', 'w061-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w061-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function renumber() {
    rows().forEach((r, i) => { r.querySelector('.w061-num').textContent = String(i + 1); });
  }
  function moved() { renumber(); clearMarks(); }
  function swapRows(a, b) {
    if (a === b) return;
    const aNext = a.nextSibling;
    if (aNext === b) { list.insertBefore(b, a); }
    else if (b.nextSibling === a) { list.insertBefore(a, b); }
    else { const bNext = b.nextSibling; list.insertBefore(a, bNext); list.insertBefore(b, aNext); }
    moved();
  }
  function makeRow(stepIdx) {
    const r = document.createElement('div');
    r.className = 'w061-step';
    r.dataset.step = String(stepIdx);
    r.draggable = true;
    const num = document.createElement('span');
    num.className = 'w061-num';
    const txt = document.createElement('span');
    txt.className = 'w061-txt';
    txt.textContent = STEPS[stepIdx];
    const mv = document.createElement('span');
    mv.className = 'w061-mv';
    const up = document.createElement('button');
    up.type = 'button'; up.textContent = '▲'; up.title = 'Move up'; up.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Move step up');
    const down = document.createElement('button');
    down.type = 'button'; down.textContent = '▼'; down.title = 'Move down'; down.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Move step down');
    up.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation(); unpick();
      const prev = r.previousElementSibling;
      if (prev) { list.insertBefore(r, prev); moved(); }
    });
    down.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation(); unpick();
      const next = r.nextElementSibling;
      if (next) { list.insertBefore(next, r); moved(); }
    });
    mv.appendChild(up); mv.appendChild(down);
    r.appendChild(num); r.appendChild(txt); r.appendChild(mv);
    r.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!picked) { picked = r; r.classList.add('w061-picked'); return; }
      if (picked === r) { unpick(); return; }
      const other = picked; unpick(); swapRows(other, r);
    });
    r.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
      unpick();
      e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', r.dataset.step);
    });
    r.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    r.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      const dragged = list.querySelector('.w061-step[data-step="' + key + '"]');
      if (!dragged || dragged === r) return;
      const rect = r.getBoundingClientRect();
      const after = (e.clientY - rect.top) > rect.height / 2;
      list.insertBefore(dragged, after ? r.nextSibling : r);
      moved();
    });
    return r;
  }
  list.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  list.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    const dragged = list.querySelector('.w061-step[data-step="' + key + '"]');
    if (dragged) { list.appendChild(dragged); moved(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w061-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    let right = 0;
    rows().forEach((r, i) => {
      r.classList.remove('w061-right', 'w061-wrong');
      if (Number(r.dataset.step) === i) { r.classList.add('w061-right'); right++; }
      else { r.classList.add('w061-wrong'); }
    });
    if (right === STEPS.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ Correct — slow handshake, fast conversation.';
      msg.className = 'w061-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + STEPS.length + ' steps are in the right place (green).';
      msg.className = 'w061-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w061-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    for (let i = 0; i < STEPS.length; i++) {
      list.appendChild(list.querySelector('.w061-step[data-step="' + i + '"]'));
    }
    moved();
    rows().forEach(r => r.classList.add('w061-right'));
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w061-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w061-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    START.forEach(idx => {
      list.appendChild(list.querySelector('.w061-step[data-step="' + idx + '"]'));
    });
    moved();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  START.forEach(idx => list.appendChild(makeRow(idx)));
  renumber();
})();
</script>
```
